homePage.title: What do you want to watch?
homePage.searchPlaceholder: A movie, a TV show, someone
homePage.intro: Find movies and TV shows, with posters, genres and ratings from TMDB.
homePage.listError: This list could not be loaded.
homePage.listsUnavailable: The lists are unavailable at the moment. Please try again later.

settings.ownKeyOptional: The app already has access to TMDB, so this is optional. A key of your own is used instead of the app's, which keeps the search working if the app's access ever stops.
settings.ownKeyRequired: This copy of the app was built without access to TMDB. Save a key of your own to be able to search.
settings.getKey: Get a key on the TMDB website
settings.invalidKey: This does not look like a TMDB key.
settings.keyNotPersisted: The key could not be saved to disk, so it is kept only until the app closes.
settings.keyNotEncrypted: This system has no keyring, so the key is saved without encryption.
settings.regionHint: The country whose streaming services, rentals and purchases the page of each title shows.
settings.regionsFailed: The list of countries could not be loaded. Try again later.
settings.sizeHint: Automatic makes everything a little bigger on a large screen.
settings.viewHint: How the search and the lists show the titles. The rows of the home page follow the size.
settings.cacheHint: The app keeps the names of the genres and the images to be faster. Clearing them makes it ask TMDB again.
settings.cacheFailed: The cache could not be cleared. Try again.

about.dataSource: Movies, TV shows, people, images and accounts come from TMDB, The Movie Database.

search.error: The search failed. Check your connection and try again.
search.errorWebUnavailable: The search is unavailable at the moment. Please try again later.
search.moreFailed: The next results could not be loaded.
search.notFoundHint: Try other words, or search everything at once.

discover.title: Explore
discover.allGenres: Titles with all the genres marked.
discover.votesHint: Only titles with at least {n} votes, for the rating to mean something.
discover.onlyMine: Only what is on my services
discover.chooseHint: Mark the services you have to see only what is on them. They are kept on this device.
discover.pickServices: Mark the services you have. They are kept on this device.
discover.filtersFailed: The filters could not be loaded.
discover.error: The titles could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
discover.errorWebUnavailable: Explore is unavailable at the moment. Please try again later.

access.noAccess: This copy of the app has no access to TMDB. Save a key of your own in the settings.
access.appRefused: TMDB refused the app's access. Update the app, or use a key of your own.
access.ownKeyRefused: TMDB refused your key. Check it or remove it in the settings.

details.notFound: This title was not found on TMDB.
details.error: The title could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
details.errorWebUnavailable: This page is unavailable at the moment. Please try again later.
details.ageCautioned: May be inappropriate for children under {age}
details.ageRestricted: Under {age} only with a parent or guardian
details.nowhereToWatch: JustWatch knows of no service, store or channel that offers it in {region}.
details.justWatch: Where to watch: data from JustWatch.

person.notFound: This person was not found on TMDB.
person.error: The page could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
person.biographyInEnglish: TMDB has this biography only in English.
person.noCredits: TMDB has no titles of this person.
person.creator: Creator

lists.signInToSave: Sign in to keep this title in your list or favorites, or to rate it
lists.statesFailed: Your lists could not be checked for this title. Try again later.
lists.saveFailed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
lists.error: Your list could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
lists.emptyWatchlist: Nothing here yet. Add movies and TV shows to your list from their pages.
lists.emptyFavorites: No favorites here yet. Mark movies and TV shows as favorites from their pages.
lists.emptyRated: Nothing rated yet. Rate movies and TV shows from their pages.
lists.rateFailed: The rating could not be saved. Try again.
lists.emptyWatched: Nothing watched yet. Mark movies and TV shows as watched from their pages.
lists.signInAgain: To mark what you watched, sign out and sign in with TMDB again: the app now keeps it in a list of your account.

account.intro: Signing in with your TMDB account is optional: the search works without it.
account.howItWorks: The approval happens on the TMDB website, in your browser. The app never sees your password.
account.waiting: Approve the access on the TMDB page that opened in your browser. This page updates by itself.
account.alreadyApproved: I already approved in the browser
account.notConfirmedYet: TMDB has not confirmed the approval yet. Approve the access in the browser and try again.
account.pageDidNotOpen: If the page did not open, copy this address into your browser:
account.offline: TMDB could not be reached, so your account was not checked. You are still signed in, and the app checks again by itself.
account.notRemembered: This system has no keyring, so you stay signed in only until the app is closed. Staying signed in after that means saving the sign-in without encryption, in a file only your user can read.
account.savedUnencrypted: This system has no keyring, so the sign-in is saved without encryption.
account.notSaved: The sign-in could not be saved to disk, so it lasts only until the app is closed.

error.denied: The access was not approved on the TMDB website.
error.timeout: The approval took too long. Start again when you are ready.
error.network: TMDB could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.unavailable: Signing in is unavailable at the moment. Please try again later.
